1.title: Chapter One: Suzie, Do You Copy?

probes.text: Dustin gets back from summer camp and drags the others up a hill to assemble a huge homemade radio tower.
Nancy and Jonathan are spending the summer as interns at the local newspaper, where the older men there belittle her.
The shiny new mall has drawn everyone away, shuttering shops downtown, and locals are furious about it.
Dustin finds Steve working behind the counter of the ice cream parlour at the new mall.
Eleven and Max spend the day shopping together at Starcourt Mall, trying on clothes to cheer themselves up.
Nancy and Jonathan visit an elderly woman's house, where she complains about rabid rats eating her fertilizer.

3.title: Chapter Three: The Case of the Missing Lifeguard

probes.text: At a sleepover, Eleven playfully uses her powers to spy on Mike, Lucas, and Will from a distance.
Will tries to get the boys to sit down for a Dungeons and Dragons campaign like old times.
Upset with his friends, Will bikes off alone and retreats to Castle Byers in the woods.
Dustin, Steve and Robin creep around the mall's loading dock, with Lucas's little sister tagging along behind them.
Will, Eleven, Mike, Lucas and Max huddle together at the deserted town pool after hours, working out a plan.
Hopper and Joyce turn up in the town mayor's office together and lean on him for answers.
